text:
Leah (Marketing Ops): Heads-up — Demo Sprint on May 12. Need final reg page, Zoom recording + SRT stream, and HubSpot routing by Monday COB. Main constraints: two CTAs, company size segmentation, 10d open replay then gated, and clip ownership.
Ethan (Growth): For CTAs: primary 'Register — Free' and secondary 'Schedule demo' (only shown when company size = 500+).
Maya (Design): Uploaded hero and mobile variants to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/demo-sprint-hero. Keep form to 6 fields.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Form fields: name, email, company, company size dropdown (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, consent checkbox (GDPR) required. Hidden field: source_detail = "demo-sprint-may12".
Olivia (Growth): Routing: company_size == "500+" -> AE queue (ae-queue); else -> SDR queue (sdr-queue). Tag 'event:demo_sprint_may12' and utm_campaign=demo_sprint_may12.
Ethan (Growth): HubSpot mapping names: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail. We'll use HS workflows for routing and attended flag.
Sam (Events): Zoom plan: cloud recording + audio transcript ON, enable "Optimize for 3rd party captions" to get SRT. Also set local recording fallback on host machine. I'll create meeting and share link.
ZoomBot: Meeting created — https://zoom.us/j/1234509876 (ID: 123-450-9876).
Leah (Marketing Ops): SRT ingest: stream to srt://ingest.redwood.example:9002/meeting123. Sam — confirm infra firewall. Also set Zoom retention to 30d but we will copy recordings to S3 and enforce 10d open replay -> gated at day 10.
Sam (Events): Infra confirmed for port 9002 from Zoom IPs. I'll run SRT test 48h before event. ZoomBot: SRT test scheduled May 10 09:00 PST.
Maya (Design): Who owns clip thumbnails? Need 3 crops + speaker headshots.
Sam (Events): I'll own clip extraction and timestamps during the session. Ethan -> final titles for clips.
Ethan (Growth): Post-event flow: 0-24h send open replay + CTA to book demo. Day 10 switch to gated replay with email-to-unlock and link to clips. Day 7 automated nurture for '500+' to alert AE with conversation starter.
Olivia (Growth): CSV export columns: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size_segment, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id, attended_live. Daily export to HS.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Privacy: consent checkbox text: "I agree to receive event and follow-up emails." Make it required. Save consent state to HS property 'gdpr_consent'.
Ethan (Growth): Add attendance webhook so registrants who join > 5 min get attended_live = true.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Good. Also add calendar ICS and one-click Google Calendar. Keep reg page to minimal friction.
Maya (Design): I'll update hero copy to call out 'live Q&A' and 10-min office hours after the session.
Sam (Events): Dress rehearsal Tuesday. Can we lock reg page + email copy by Monday 10am?
Ethan (Growth): Monday 10am is fine. I'll finalize HS workflows and share runbook.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Ownership recap: Leah = reg page + consent copy + HS fields; Maya = hero + thumbnails; Sam = Zoom setup, SRT, clips; Ethan = email sequences + HS routing; Olivia = AE routing rules + exports.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Quick checklist to thumbs-up when done: GDPR checkbox, company-size dropdown, hidden source_detail field, SRT endpoint configured, HubSpot mappings, 10d open -> gated at 10, clip owners assigned.
Olivia (Growth): :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): :thumbsup:
Sam (Events): :thumbsup:
Ethan (Growth): :thumbsup:
ZoomBot: Reminder scheduled: SRT test May 10 09:00 PST.
